messages:
diana: Quick heads-up  Console shows SLO tiles spiking into dozens of rows during bursts. Telemetry says notify events lack a stable grouping key. Who owns the notify schema? cc @tom

 tom: Platform owns it. What exact key do you want?

 diana: A stable_group_id (string) created by the evaluator, plus event_class enum (slo_violation, sample, anomaly).

 alec: Also want evaluator_resolved_threshold and pipeline_latency_ms for triage. Otherwise Console shows configured thresholds that don't match what fired.

 tom: Backcompat is important. Proposal: opt-in header X-Notify-Version: 2; new fields optional at first. Telemetry will compute a fallback hash when stable_group_id missing.

 ui: UX ask: Console should show an "inferred" badge when grouping used the fallback hash so customers know grouping may change on full rollout. Also add tenant opt-in toggle so customers can preview grouping.

 diana: Operational rule: events with event_class=="sample" must be metrics-only (no paging). If later same stable_group_id emits slo_violation, that should page. Add runbook note.

 tom: I'll open a PR with schema + examples. Example payload: {"tenant":"org-5","event_class":"slo_violation","stable_group_id":"slo:org-5:err_rate:5m","ts":1729998800,"evaluator_resolved_threshold":"0.02"}

 alec: Include source_hint (slo-evaluator, synthetic) and ttl_seconds so Console can collapse stale tiles.

 sre-bot: rollout-bot: notify-api v2 shadow-run scheduled 2024-06-15 03:00 UTC (epoch 1719912000). Bot will collect clients missing v2 fields during shadow period.

 tom: Sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC with SDK, Telemetry, Console, SRE to finalize fields and migration checklist. Diana please add agenda.

 diana: Added: required/optional fields, header semantics, shadow metrics to collect (grouping_match_rate, inferred_pct), tenant preview UI, runbook paging rules. Thanks! :thumbsup:
